summary: Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime! As the Engineering Operations Director in Hyderabad, India, you will be a strategic partner to Engineering leadership, ensuring the successful scaling and smooth operation of our rapidly growing India-based Engineering organization.
responsibilities: Act as the primary Operations leader for the Engineering organization in Hyderabad, ensuring local needs are addressed while staying aligned with global standards and processes.
Partner with Talent Acquisition to scale recruiting and hiring operations, ensuring consistency, speed, and quality in processes.
Implement operational best practices to increase efficiency, reduce duplication, and enable Engineering leaders to focus on technical strategy and execution.
Provide reporting on hiring, attrition, and organizational health to Engineering leadership and the VP of Operations.
required_skills: 15+ years of experience in Operations, Business Management, or related roles in a fast-scaling tech or engineering-driven environment.
Strong understanding of Engineering org structures, processes, and rhythms.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills — able to connect operational details to business strategy.
nice_to_have_skills: Experience scaling teams in India strongly preferred.
benefits: Best-in class medical, dental, and vision private insurance healthcare coverage
Access to counseling & mental health sessions 24/7 through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Company's Paid Parental Leave up to 26 weeks for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents
